Promptfoo version 0.123.0 uses the Responses API by default for GPT-5.6 and newer models. This change is indicated as a breaking change in the release notes, which specifies that the default for these models has been switched to Responses.

The relevant line from the context is:  
"**providers:** default GPT-5.6+ to Responses ([#10803](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10803))" [promptfoo/0.123.0.md (lines 9-23)].

Additionally, this is supported by the following line:  
"Responses supports text, image and file inputs, built-in tools, and response state. GPT-5.6 and newer models use it by default:" [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/openai.md (lines 408-430)].
